title: KKR Expands Home Services Portfolio with $2 Billion A1 Deal
title_zh: KKR Expands Home Services Portfolio with $2 Billion A1 Deal
summary: KKR & Co. Inc. (NYSE:KKR) has agreed to acquire A1 Garage Door Service, a Phoenix-based residential garage door repair and replacement company, for around $2 billion, Reuters reported on September 2, citing sources familiar with the matter.

title: KKR (KKR) Bets On Data Centres, Home Services And Healthcare With New Deals
title_zh: KKR (KKR) Bets On Data Centres, Home Services And Healthcare With New Deals
summary: KKR (NYSE:KKR) is ramping up activity in digital infrastructure, home services and healthcare with a series of new deals. The firm agreed to acquire a majority stake in global data centre operator ST Telemedia Global Data Centres in recent days.
